scope: Read-only source runtime reconciliation for page264 acceptance; no WordPress/browser mutation.
before_after_contract: The native range input's input event writes --ba-pos from input.value.
Broken BA layer image handling removes the closest .ba figure; no replacement UI is synthesized.
carousel_contract: Each .js-carousel initializes once through data-af-carousel-init=1 when track and at least one slide exist.
render() applies track translateX, slide aria-hidden, dot aria-current, counter, caption and carousel--single state.
manual is initialized once from carousel--manual and never changed by user interaction.
start() first stop()s any existing interval, then refuses a new 4000ms timer when manual, reduced-motion, fewer than two slides or disconnected.
Prev/next, dot, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight and qualified swipe move then call start(), so non-manual navigation resets/restarts the countdown.
mouseenter/focusin stop; mouseleave/focusout start without separate hover/focus state flags.
broken_slide_contract: drop() removes the slide and matching dot and reindexes remaining dots.
If no slides remain: drop() calls stop(), hides the nearest .project-card__extra/.hero-proof owner or carousel, then returns.
If exactly one slide remains: drop() calls stop() through the slides.length<2 branch, then clamps and re-renders with go(...).
If two or more slides remain: drop() does not stop/start; it clamps and re-renders, leaving the existing timer cadence un-reset by the removal itself.
superseded_claims: v001 source-runtime statement that drop() itself calls neither stop() nor start() in all cases
v001 pointer to interaction v002 as current plan
target_policy: These source facts do not prove a target failure. Preserve the existing target BA/carousel owner; require synchronized live evidence and owner readback before any runtime mutation.
